Package com.thefreshmanjourney.controller.editor

Class EditorCommandManager

java.lang.Object
com.thefreshmanjourney.controller.editor.EditorCommandManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.badlogic.gdx.InputProcessor
public class EditorCommandManager extends Object implements com.badlogic.gdx.InputProcessor
This class represents a controller that manages editor user inputs.

      public boolean touchCancelled(int screenX, int screenY, int pointer, int button)
      Description copied from interface: com.badlogic.gdx.InputProcessor
      Called when the touch gesture is cancelled. Reason may be from OS interruption to touch becoming a large surface such as the user cheek). Relevant on Android and iOS only. The button parameter will be Input.Buttons.LEFT on iOS.
      Specified by:
      touchCancelled in interface com.badlogic.gdx.InputProcessor
      pointer - the pointer for the event.
      button - the button
      Returns:
      whether the input was processed
